sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Yadav Rahul Ramkrishana, learned counsel for
opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge-sheet dated 27.10.2020 as
well as entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.165 of 2020 (State vs. Tariq Khan and others) arising
out of Case Crime No. 71 of 2019 under Sections- 498A, 323 Ipc Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police
Station- Mahila Thana, District Rampur.
3.  Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have reconciled their differences and a compromise have entered between them which has been reduced in writing.
Copy of the same is annexed as Annexure No.(5) to the present application.
It is further submitted that a copy of the compromise dated 23.8.2023 has already been filed by the parties before the court below.

Tariq Khan And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92153754/

entities.text: Tariq Khan And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned AGA appearing for the opposite party no. 1 as well as learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 does not dispute the correctness of the aforesaid submission made by learned counsel for the applicants.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, direction is issued to the court below to fix a date for the verification of the compromise dated 23.8.2023 entered into between the parties and pass an appropriate order to that effect within next six weeks.
6. In view of the above, the present application is disposed of.
7. For a period of ten weeks or till the final order passed on the compromise application by the court below whichever is earlier, no coercive measure shall be taken against the applicants.
8. In case, the applicants are still aggrieved or if no action is taken, it will be open for the applicants to approach this Court afresh.

Order Date :- 15.9.2023/S.K.
